what: Polynomial maps two 2026 papers print, decided in exact rational arithmetic: Gao's counterexamples to the Jacobian conjecture (constant Jacobian determinant expanded symbolically, non-injectivity by two rational points with one image) and the weak Markus–Yamabe fields ((JX + I)^N = 0 as a polynomial identity, distinct zeros by evaluation).

gao.title: Counterexamples to the Jacobian conjecture in dimensions greater than two
gao.author: Shuhong Gao
gao.aiDisclosure: "AI disclosure: The main idea and framework are due to the author, and Claude Fable 5 assisted in the proofs and in the writing up of the paper." (title footnote)
gao.checkingStatement: "All polynomial identities asserted below ... were verified by exact rational arithmetic; the verification scripts are available from the author." (p. 2); pp. 24 and 28 promise ancillary files with F6 and F7, which arXiv does not carry

chv.title: The weak Markus–Yamabe conjecture fails in dimension 14
chv.authors: Álvaro Castañeda, Gerardo Honorato, Francisco Valenzuela-Henríquez
chv.provenance: Phi (Prop 6.2) equals, all 11 components, the map of gist.github.com/Spacerat/08b4a43f6b6ca57178efabc220170ce8 (revision 2224dace of 2026-07-20, its only revision; the file 11varcubicjacobiancounter.py is git blob 1f974e34), which says: "The explicit 11-variable construction, simplification, and verification code in this file were generated by ChatGPT (OpenAI)." The appendix checks the 18-dimensional unipotency "at a sample rational point".
